notes: Blocks Vine-Walnut, 6th to Fountain Square and Fountain Square to 4th. Mid-block N-S alley north of the square printed FOUNTAIN PL. (24' at 6th, 20' at the square); south of the square STONE ALLEY (18', narrowing to 10' at the 4th St end). THORP AL. (8') runs Vine to Fountain Pl; HATTERS ALLEY (10') runs Vine to Walnut, its two halves offset ~29 px at Fountain Pl (west half centre y~1955, east half y~1926), recorded as one jogged cross. BURKE ALLEY runs Vine to Stone Alley (width label unclear, possibly 8'). OPERA PL. comes in from the west side of Vine (about 40 ft). 5th St: west of Vine printed W. 5TH ST. (66 ft roadway, centre y~2401); between Vine and Walnut it is FOUNTAIN SQUARE, 139' overall, with a central esplanade (y~2420-2621) and north/south roadways; the square is widened to the south so its axis (y~2520) is ~120 px south of the W 5th axis, hence two T's on Vine. East of Walnut the same street is printed GOVERNMENT SQ.; Walnut/Fountain Square is a cross on the square axis. Fountain Place meets the north roadway (roadway centre y~2356) and Stone Alley the south roadway (roadway centre y~2686); their T points are recorded where the alley centrelines meet the square axis (y~2520), per the centreline rule. Unnamed alley entries: a ~22 ft alley stub north of 6th at x~2099 (block on sheet 131, offset ~50 px east of Fountain Pl) and two unnamed alleys entering Vine from the west (Vol. 1 side) at y~1238 (11 ft, ~24 px south of Thorp) and y~1920 (14 ft, ~35 px north of Hatters); only their stubs are on this sheet.
